title: Storybound Adventure Menu theme
description: assets/storybound/storybound/menu/theme.json in a resource pack. Sprites are GUI sprites (assets/<ns>/textures/gui/sprites/<path>.png), usually nine-sliced by their .mcmeta.

journal_book.description: Use the textured travel journal, illustrated bookmark buttons and serif font. Takes precedence over archive_chrome; omit to retain the previous layout.

chrome_palette.description: Material palette for archive_chrome: dark archive or warm traveler's parchment. Set matching text colors below.

archive_chrome.description: Draw pixel-aligned charcoal archive panels and tabs instead of panel/tab sprites. Omit or disable to use resource-pack sprites. Text and accent colors still use this theme.
